caseNameFull: RISS & CO., INC. v. DALTON, ATTORNEY GENERAL
attorneys: John B. Gage, Laird P. Bowman and A. Alvis Layne for appellants., John M. Dalton, Attorney General of Missouri, Fred L. Howard, Assistant Attorney General, and Raymond S. Roberts, Special Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Whittaker took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
